text:
Kai: Quick design sync about the playground stream UI — small proposal.
Kai: Problem: when token throughput drops we append micro-chunks forever and people think the model is hung. Idea: after a short threshold collapse the trailing fragments into a single inline "stream paused" chip that shows a token count and a primary action.
Rina: Love collapsing. UX Q: should clicking the chip expand the buffered text or open actions? I think expand by default, actions in a small toolbar.
Omar: Expand + toolbar sounds good. For resumable streams show primary action "Resume streaming"; for non-resumable show "Regenerate". We need to surface meta.can_resume from the runtime.
Leah: Accessibility: don't keep firing aria-live for every fragment. Keep chunk region aria-live="polite" and when we collapse write a short role="status" message: "Stream paused, 11 tokens buffered." Make the chip tabbable and include an aria-label that lists available actions.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: chip tabindex=0, announce once on collapse, tooltips on focus, visible focus ring (2px), and ensure collapse doesn't steal focus from keyboard users. Rate-limit announcements.
Kai: Token visibility: show a tiny tag like "14 tks" next to time. Allow pinning per-conversation. Tooltip text: "Token usage for this response" and must be keyboard accessible.
Rina: Gesture notes: on mobile long-press should open the actions sheet (Resume | Stop | Copy | Edit prompt). Floating toolbar should be desktop-only for messages > 6 lines.
Omar: Telemetry: playground.stream_collapsed, playground.resume_click, playground.regenerate_click. Include buffered_tokens and trigger (user|network|runtime) in payload. Keep payload small.
Leah: Microcopy: Chip text options: "Stream paused 1 tokens" vs "Streaming paused 1 tokens buffered" vs "Output paused (15)". I prefer concise: "Stream paused 1 tokens".
Kai: Dev spike: Omar will prototype the pill + expand + toolbar and push a demo branch. Please call out keyboard shortcut hints (Resume = Cmd/Ctrl+Enter).
Rina: A/B test suggestion: toolbar vs inline micro-actions and "Resume" vs "Regenerate" wording. Instrument confusion and regen rates.
Omar: Pushing branch playground/stream-collapse-pill now, will share preview link.
Kai: Thanks all 680 ping here when demo is up.
Leah: Small nit: ensure the prompt-library link (if message came from a saved prompt) sits next to token tag and is keyboard reachable.
